name: Àngela y Archie: Tras la pantalla
original_name: Àngela y Archie: Tras la pantalla
overview: Àngela Mármol and Archie Ted are going through their first major relationship crisis while their public lives continue as usual. Amid trips, photo shoots, and events, they must reconnect and rediscover each other, striking a balance between what they show their followers and what they experience behind the scenes. A premiere in Berlin becomes the perfect opportunity to turn everything around between them.
